title: Free Shark made with Gemini 3.8 Flash
author: Accomplished-Fan9568
selftext:
Here is an oceanic whitetip i developed with Gemini 3.8 flash, free to download. 

I was hoping we could maybe get more into sharing some of our creations so here's one im pretty happy with.

Feel free to use for whatever project if u add credits.  
Credits to "MonstaTrucka"
